t.zh: 数有了，还没有加法。定义一个函数，就是按要拆开的那个数，每个构造子写一行：0 + y 等于什么，S x + y 等于什么。右边可以再用加法，但要拆的数必须变小，否则算不完。
t.en: There are numbers, but no addition yet. To define a function, write one row for each constructor of the number it takes apart: what 0 + y is, and what S x + y is. A right side may use addition again, but only on a smaller number, or it never finishes.

after.zh: Lean 把这样的定义编译成自然数的递推子 Nat.rec。
after.en: Lean compiles such a definition into the recursor of the numbers, Nat.rec.

brief.zh: 给每一行选一个右边，让每个测试都算对。
brief.en: Pick a right side for every row so that every test works out right.

hint.zh: S x + y 比 x + y 多一。
hint.en: S x + y is one more than x + y.
